methodology.purpose: Detect source-retention misses without changing historical evidence or production data.
methodology.role_logic: Current monitor city/explosion/air-context functions applied to event-local source windows.
methodology.safe_anchor_gate: SAFE_SOURCE_RETENTION_CANDIDATE requires a shared exact clock time with retained evidence and no other clock time or explicit different-daypart marker in the local window.
methodology.same_attack_gate: Exact city + strict explosion + air context must co-occur in the same event-local window.
methodology.source_scope: Only source URLs already retained in the frozen QA bundle.
methodology.weak_anchor_gate: Cases without a safe exact-time window remain weak/manual even if the page contains all roles elsewhere.
